content.text:
The drawing shows a benzene ring with three substituents:

- A nitrile (C≡N) at the top right.
- A nitro group (O2N) on the upper-left carbon, which sits meta to the nitrile.
- A methoxy group (O–CH3) on the lower-left carbon, which sits para to the nitrile and ortho to the nitro group.

This is 4-methoxy-3-nitrobenzonitrile.

SMILES: COc1ccc(C#N)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]
